_metadata.description: PG&E delivery + multi-CCA generation rate data. Schema v2.1: ccaGeneration replaces the old cce key. Each rate plan's rates.ccaGeneration maps CCA IDs to their generation rates for that plan.
notes: All energy rates are $/kWh unless otherwise noted.
delivery = totalBundled - pgeGeneration (per tariff UNBUNDLING tables).
PGE bundled rate = delivery + pgeGeneration = totalBundled.
PCIA and Franchise Fee are flat per-kWh charges billed separately by PG&E to CCA customers, not embedded in the TOU energy rates.
Base Services Charge (BSC) is a daily fixed charge, not included in per-kWh rates. Show in UI footnote only.
Baseline Credit (E-TOU-C only) is applied to usage within baseline allowance; not embedded in the per-kWh rates shown here.
Schema v2.1: ccaGeneration replaces the old cce key. Separation prevents double-counting CCA rates (was v1 bug).
Ava (EBCE) rates include System Fees ($0.05115/kWh) embedded — do not add PCIA/FF on top for Ava.
Pioneer rates are blended flat rates with no TOU differentiation — same value applied to all periods and seasons.
KCCP rates are blended with no TOU differentiation and are only available for E-1 and E-TOU-C.
RCEA EV-B rates sourced from EV-A schedule (EV-A was eliminated Nov 30 2025; EV-B is the successor plan).
SVCE rates use TOU-specific April 2025 table (not the blended 2026 table).
